content:
GO.

Exit Plan Mode and execute the final IVX certification.

Scope:

1. Fix the remaining terminal-state completion defect.
2. Commit the fix.
3. Deploy only if required.
4. Run the complete enterprise certification.

Certification must include:

• Owner Authentication
• Member Authentication
• IVX IA Chat
• Autonomous Coder
• QA Runtime
• Production Deployment
• Security Audit
• Chat Module
• Admin Hub
• Variables
• Landing Page
• Mobile App
• APK
• Regression Tests
• Health Endpoints
• Runtime Verification

Do not add features.
Do not refactor unrelated code.

Return only live evidence:

• Commit SHA
• GitHub HEAD
• Render Deploy ID
• Runtime SHA
• /health
• APK version
• APK URL
• Tests passed/failed
• Typecheck
• Production verification

For every section return only:

PASS
or
FAIL

If FAIL, provide:

• exact file
• exact root cause
• exact corrective action

Do not mark PASS without live evidence.

The objective is to certify IVX IA Chat as an owner-controlled senior developer for production.
